resources.string: Joining is lasting membership, not active presence. Browsing these details does not show you as active in a room.
Open a room conversation to read and send messages. Live updates require a connection; active room presence can expire after inactivity.
Room information may be out of date. Refresh before changing membership or creating a room.
Have an unlisted room link? Enter its numeric room ID. Knowing an ID does not grant private-room access.
No rooms are available to this account.
Public rooms are discoverable. Joining is required to post and receive room realtime events.
Unlisted rooms are hidden from ordinary discovery until joined or invited. People who know the ID can view their public metadata and history.
Private rooms require membership or privileged moderation access to read history. An invitation allows viewing metadata and joining.
An invitation reveals room details, not private message history. Join first; the server checks your invitation and age.

resources.string: This removes your membership, not past messages. A private room may require a new invitation to rejoin.
Room ownership cannot be transferred here. The owner cannot leave the room.
You will become the permanent owner and a member of this room. Room management and deletion are not available in this build.
3–48 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; start with a letter or digit. The server lowercases and trims the key.
Public: discoverable. Unlisted: accessible by ID, hidden from ordinary discovery. Private: invitation or privileged access required; invited users must join before reading history.
Use 0 to disable, or 120–86400 seconds. Expiring active presence does not remove room membership.
Guests are allowed only in public rooms with minimum age 0. Your choices are preserved; change incompatible settings explicitly.
Room request cancelled. Refresh to check current state.
The membership or creation request may have succeeded. It will not be replayed. Check current room state before attempting another change.
Room information could not be confirmed. Check your connection, then refresh. Existing details may be out of date.
Enter a positive numeric room ID.
This room is unavailable or you no longer have permission to view it.
A current invitation is required to join this private room.
This room requires a birth date on your account. Update your account in the browser, then refresh here.
Your account does not meet this room’s minimum age.
You are no longer a member. Refresh the room details.
Your current account is not allowed to perform this room action. Refresh to check your permissions.
That room key is already used. Check existing rooms before choosing another key.
Use a 3–48 character room key with letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
Enter a room name with 1–120 characters.
Room information must not exceed 255 characters.
Choose public, unlisted or private visibility.
Minimum age must be between 0 and 120.
Inactivity timeout must be 0, or between 120 and 86400 seconds.
Enter whole numbers for minimum age and inactivity timeout.
